contradictions.detail: The disclaimer says prices are 'plus Tax, DMV, $85 Documentation Fee and Dealer installed accessories'. The dealer disclosure says 'Price includes all dealer fees' and 'No additional dealer fees.' The out-the-door terms need confirming in writing.

critical_evidence.evidence: No statement on track or autocross use, oil consumption or compression. 'One owner, low miles' does not establish it.
The exterior appears stock in the one photo, but there is no statement or scan on ECU tune or headers. California compliance is unverified.
NHTSA 18V772000 applies to 2013 cars; this VIN decodes as a 2017.
The profile scopes NHTSA 21V587000 to 2018-2019 cars; this is a 2017. The tracker's recall lookup returned none. A Subaru dealer open-recall check by VIN is still prudent.

documentation.rationale: The identity and terms half is present: the VIN is printed and decodes cleanly, and there is an itemised price, a claimed one-owner clean Carfax, and a full equipment list. The maintenance half is missing: no invoices, no Carfax service lines and no detail of the 'just serviced' work in what was captured. The capture was incomplete, so records may exist on the full listing.

condition.rationale: One photo shows a straight, clean, stock-appearing car with intact front bumper, lamps and wheels, and no visible curb rash at this resolution. Low claimed mileage. Tires, underside, interior, clutch and engine bay were not examined here, and no inspection report is shown.

price_value.rationale: The $22,999 ask is above the fair value range of $18,047-$21,589 (mid $19,016), and this is the entry Premium trim. Active peers include a 2018 Limited with Performance Package at 28k mi for $21,895, and a 2017 Limited with 8k mi sold for $24,500.

mission_fit.rationale: This is a manual, naturally aspirated, simple Toyota-co-developed coupe that is available now and easy to resell in 6-24 months, which is exactly the secondary bridge type. The asking price sits above the ideal band but under the ceiling.

logistics.rationale: The dealer is 66 mi away in Fremont, CA, the car is a California dealer car with smog the dealer's obligation, and an easy test drive is possible. PPI permission is not yet confirmed.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: This is the base Premium trim with cloth seats and no Performance Package in common silver, which pulls it down. A manual and an apparently stock, low-mile, single-owner car lift it slightly above a pure base-trim score.

ppi_focus: ECU calibration ID check against stock Subaru calibration; scan for stored and pending codes and readiness monitors
Clutch engagement point, slip test in high gear, throwout bearing noise, and synchro feel in 2nd and 3rd
Compression or leakdown and oil condition, to screen for hidden hard use
Underside inspection for scraped front lip, subframe or crossmember marks, and any jacking-point damage from track or lowered use
Paint meter on all panels to test the 'no reported accident' claim
Tire DOT dates, matching brand and size, and an uneven wear pattern indicating alignment or hard use
Cold start for injector tick versus abnormal noise, and the known FA20 low-RPM fuel pump whine
Brake pad and rotor wear, and brake fluid moisture
Differential and transmission fluid leaks and condition
Open-recall check with a Subaru dealer by VIN
what_would_change_verdict: A full Carfax with regular service entries and a reconditioning invoice would lift documentation
A clean independent PPI (stock ECU, healthy clutch, no paint work, fresh-dated tires) would lift condition
A negotiated price inside the fair value range of about $19,000-$21,500 would materially improve price_value
Evidence of a flashed ECU, track wear, paint work or aged tires would move it down
evidence.mission_note: This is a credible enthusiast bridge: a manual, naturally aspirated, low-maintenance coupe nearby in California that should resell easily within 6-24 months. Its main weakness against the brief is paying an above-market price for the entry trim.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well. The VIN is printed and decodes to a 2017 BRZ 2.0L coupe, consistent with the stated 6-speed manual, Premium trim, Ice Silver and 38,754 miles. The single attached photo of this car shows a straight, clean, stock-appearing example, and the other attached photos are unrelated dealer inventory. One owner and no reported accident come from a Carfax summary, not an attached report, and the 'just serviced' and '140-point inspection' claims carry no invoices in what was captured. Nothing is observed wrong mechanically. The asking price of $22,999 sits above the computed fair value range of $18,047-$21,589, and there is a minor conflict in the listing's fee language. Track history, tune status, tire age and clutch condition remain open. Both recall items are not applicable to a 2017 car.
evidence.next_action: Email the dealer asking for the full Carfax, the reconditioning repair order, tire DOT code photos, written out-the-door terms, and written permission for an independent PPI in Fremont before any deposit.
